cenas.editar: Photorealistic full-frame photo, 9:16 vertical. No people, no hands. No phone frame, no device bezel, no borders, no added text. The armchair placed in a bright, elegant living room with a large window, light linen curtains, a light woven rug and a green plant, plain off-white walls, soft daylight. The armchair faces the camera at a slight three-quarter angle like reference photo 1. The backrest shows clear diamond tufting with sunken buttons in a grid, exactly as in reference photo 1, plainly visible from this angle. EXACT armchair from reference photos 1 and 2: upholstery in a matte, flat-woven MEDIUM NAVY BLUE fabric (same blue as reference photo 1, not dark, not black, not velvet sheen, not teal), diamond quilting ONLY on the backrest, plain smooth seat cushion; honey-varnished bent wood arms that curve from the top of the backrest forward and down into the front legs in one continuous band, straight wooden rear legs. Neutral white daylight with no orange or yellow cast, so the fabric color stays identical to reference photo 1. Wide shot from a little farther away: the WHOLE armchair, legs included, fits between 25% and 60% of the image height, with empty floor below it down to the bottom edge.
cenas.movimento: Slow push-in toward the armchair with a slight handheld feel.
